hooks.name: spec-drift-check
hooks.description: When a spec tasks.md changes, verify ticked tasks have matching code/tests and report drift.

action.prompt:
A spec task list (.kiro/specs/<name>/tasks.md) was just saved. Check it for spec/code drift. REPORT ONLY: do not edit any file, do not tick or untick boxes, do not commit or push.

1. Read the changed tasks.md (and the same spec's requirements.md/design.md if needed for context).
2. For every ticked item (`- [x]`), find the code and tests it names (files, functions, constants, test names) in the repo. For ticked `Commit:` lines, check `git log --oneline` for a matching commit.
3. Also flag the reverse: unticked items (`- [ ]`) whose code/tests already exist.
4. Items that are manual (webcam playthrough, enabling GitHub Pages, etc.) are 'manual - not checkable', not drift.
5. Print a short table: task | status (OK / DRIFT / UNTICKED-BUT-DONE / MANUAL) | evidence or what is missing. End with a one-line verdict.
